fields.description: The account this company posts output VAT to — both ordinary sales VAT and, on a Purchase Invoice, the self-accounted output VAT liability for Reverse Charge purchases.
fields.label: Output VAT Account

fields.description: The account this company posts recoverable input VAT to — on a Purchase Invoice, the offsetting input VAT credit for a self-accounted Reverse Charge purchase. Only required if this company uses Reverse Charge Applicable; not used for ordinary Sales Invoice validation.
fields.label: Input VAT Account
